package api

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// 所有故障模式均为单次调用私有值，不使用可变全局开关。
type i8r17FailWriter struct {
	dst     *bytes.Buffer
	partial bool
}

func (w i8r17FailWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if w.partial {
		n, err := w.dst.Write(p[:7])
		if err != nil {
			return n, err
		}
		return n, io.ErrClosedPipe
	}
	return 0, io.ErrClosedPipe
}
func i8r17WriterFor(dst *bytes.Buffer, r slog.Record) io.Writer {
	switch r.Message {
	case "i8r17-fail":
		return i8r17FailWriter{dst: dst}
	case "i8r17-partial":
		return i8r17FailWriter{dst: dst, partial: true}
	default:
		return dst
	}
}
func i8r17Record(msg string) slog.Record {
	return slog.NewRecord(time.Unix(1, 0), slog.LevelInfo, msg, 0)
}

func TestI8R17InjectedRenderLine(t *testing.T) {
	for _, msg := range []string{"i8r17-fail", "i8r17-partial"} {
		t.Run(msg, func(t *testing.T) {
			line, err := renderLine(slog.LevelInfo, i8r17Record(msg))
			if err != io.ErrClosedPipe {
				t.Errorf("renderLine未原样返回writer错误: %T", err)
			}
			if line != "" {
				t.Error("renderLine返回失败的部分文本")
			}
		})
	}
}

type i8r17Snapshot struct {
	epoch            string
	seq              uint64
	ring             [logRingSize]logEntry
	pos, count, next int
	subs             map[int]chan logEntry
}

func i8r17State(b *LogBroadcaster) i8r17Snapshot {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	subs := make(map[int]chan logEntry, len(b.subs))
	for id, ch := range b.subs {
		subs[id] = ch
	}
	return i8r17Snapshot{b.epoch, b.seq, b.ring, b.ringPos, b.ringCnt, b.next, subs}
}
func i8r17Drain(t *testing.T, ch <-chan logEntry, want int) []logEntry {
	t.Helper()
	if len(ch) != want {
		t.Fatalf("队列条数=%d want=%d", len(ch), want)
	}
	var entries []logEntry
	for i := 0; i < want; i++ {
		entries = append(entries, <-ch)
	}
	return entries
}

// 所有调用均同步完成，零投递断言不使用sleep或超时猜测。
func TestI8R17InjectedNoPublish(t *testing.T) {
	for _, seed := range []int{0, 3, logRingSize + 5} {
		for _, msg := range []string{"i8r17-fail", "i8r17-partial"} {
			t.Run(strings.Join([]string{"seed_" + strconv.Itoa(seed), msg}, "/"), func(t *testing.T) {
				b := NewLogBroadcaster("info")
				for i := 0; i < seed; i++ {
					if err := b.Handle(t.Context(), i8r17Record("seed")); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				ch1, _, _, cancel1 := b.Subscribe(b.epoch + ":" + strconv.FormatUint(b.seq, 10))
				defer cancel1()
				ch2, _, _, cancel2 := b.Subscribe(b.epoch + ":" + strconv.FormatUint(b.seq, 10))
				defer cancel2()
				before := i8r17State(b)
				previousLogger := slog.Default()
				var diagnostics bytes.Buffer
				slog.SetDefault(slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&diagnostics, nil)))
				defer slog.SetDefault(previousLogger)
				if err := b.Handle(context.Background(), i8r17Record(msg)); err != io.ErrClosedPipe {
					t.Errorf("Handle未原样返回渲染错误: %T", err)
				}
				if after := i8r17State(b); !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
					t.Error("失败改变序号/ring/订阅状态")
				}
				i8r17Drain(t, ch1, 0)
				i8r17Drain(t, ch2, 0)
				if diagnostics.Len() != 0 {
					t.Error("失败递归记录日志")
				}
				replay, _, _, cancelReplay := b.Subscribe("")
				defer cancelReplay()
				count := seed
				if count > logRingSize {
					count = logRingSize
				}
				entries := i8r17Drain(t, replay, count)
				for _, e := range entries {
					if !strings.Contains(e.Line, "msg=seed") {
						t.Error("失败污染历史回放")
					}
				}
				// 失败后的成功仍占用下一个连续序号，并投递给原订阅者及新订阅者。
				if err := b.Handle(t.Context(), i8r17Record("recovered")); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				for _, ch := range []<-chan logEntry{ch1, ch2, replay} {
					got := i8r17Drain(t, ch, 1)[0]
					if got.Seq != before.seq+1 || !strings.Contains(got.Line, "msg=recovered") {
						t.Errorf("失败后成功日志未连续投递: %+v", got)
					}
				}
				replay2, _, _, cancelReplay2 := b.Subscribe(b.epoch + ":" + strconv.FormatUint(before.seq, 10))
				defer cancelReplay2()
				if got := i8r17Drain(t, replay2, 1)[0]; got.Seq != before.seq+1 {
					t.Error("增量回放游标不连续")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

type i8r17MarshalError struct{}

func (i8r17MarshalError) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) { return nil, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF }

type i8r17MarshalPanic struct{}

func (i8r17MarshalPanic) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) { panic("i8r17-format-panic") }
func TestI8R17InjectedAttributeFailureIsText(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		value  any
		marker string
	}{{i8r17MarshalError{}, "!ERROR"}, {i8r17MarshalPanic{}, "!PANIC"}} {
		r := i8r17Record("attribute-marker")
		r.AddAttrs(slog.Any("value", tc.value))
		line, err := renderLine(slog.LevelInfo, r)
		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(line, tc.marker) {
			t.Fatalf("属性格式化边界与预期不同: line=%q err=%v", line, err)
		}
	}
}
